text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data without being directly programmed. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build models, which are like rules it creates to understand patterns. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it might predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy — how often the model gets the right answer. Good training data usually leads to better models and more accurate predictions.
